item.title: 15th IEA Heat Pump Conference: Decarbonisation through Innovation
item.description: The leading scientific conference and meeting place for academia, industry, market, policy makers and investors interested in the field of heat pumping technologies. Under the motto ‘Decarbonisation through Innovation’, experts from all over the world will meet to present and discuss the latest advances and developments.

item.title: Innovative heat pump solutions: Research for efficient and sustainable heating and cooling
item.description: Heat pumps are considered a key technology for the energy transition. The Federal Ministry for Innovation, Mobility and Infrastructure is therefore promoting research into innovative heat pump technologies.
